scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @jobenapp/shared && concurrently --names API,WEB "npm run dev --workspace @jobenapp/api" "npm run dev --workspace @jobenapp/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @jobenapp/shared && npm run build --workspace @jobenapp/engine && npm run build --workspace @jobenapp/api && npm run build --workspace @jobenapp/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @jobenapp/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @jobenapp/engine && npm run typecheck --workspace @jobenapp/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @jobenapp/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @jobenapp/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
